primary_date_population: the 32 fixed GraphCast-FuXi common 2022 initializations; no event-enriched dates

tropical_cyclone.definition: a valid-time grid point within 500 km of an IBTrACS storm centre

cold_surge.definition: a 48 h ERA5 2 m temperature fall of at least 6 K whose final state is below the pre-2022 local p05 climatological threshold
cold_surge.independent_system_unit: initialization date with a non-empty affected mask

non_tropical_high_wind.definition: ERA5 wind speed at or above both the pre-2022 local q97.5 threshold and 20 m s-1 after excluding tropical-cyclone influence masks
non_tropical_high_wind.independent_system_unit: initialization date with a non-empty affected mask

reporting_rule: strata below the minimum count are descriptive only and cannot support a superiority claim
selection_contract: definitions and thresholds are independent of PS-PaE-Fuse/Pangu comparative performance
